pieces.Text: The purifier can consume a curse, enchantment, or emotion effect by touch as a full-round action. She can do this
times per day, and must make a Charisma check with a bonus equal of

against a DC of 11 + the caster level of the effect (or the Hit Dice of the creator for a supernatural effect). If the check succeeds, the effect is negated; however, the purifier is sickened for 1d4 rounds. If the target is possessed (such as by a magic jar effect or a ghost's malevolence ability), the possessor is forced out on a successful check. Whether the check succeeds or fails, the possessor is sickened for 2d4 rounds.
